claims.statement: Maintain the operating margin guidance between the 18% and 20% band going ahead.
claims.quote: So, I would say that we would keep the guidance between that 18 and 20% band as we go ahead and that is something which we will endeavour to maintain.

claims.statement: Expect volume growth in the current context to be between 8% and 10%.
claims.quote: anything in the volume, in the current context, which is between that 8% - 10% is a good growth, in terms of what I would say under the current circumstances.

claims.statement: Expect a 4% to 5% value growth to be realistically expected in the next few quarters.
claims.quote: I think that is a reasonable take in terms of what we can look at.

claims.statement: Expect the volume-value gap of about 4% to 5% to remain in the market for some time.
claims.quote: So, I would say that this 4%-5% is a more realistic thing which would remain in the market

facts.statement: The company launched the NeoBharat latex paints product focusing on the rural market and seeded it in certain states.
facts.quote: we had launched “NeoBharat” and we have been pursuing it very strongly. So, we have looked at the latex market... we have seeded it in certain states

facts.statement: The company is pursuing growth in B2B and industrial segments.
facts.quote: we are putting a lot of effort in those areas, as we want to grow, namely the B2B and the industrial.

facts.statement: The coatings industry growth was about 4.4% with volume level growth at 8.3%.
facts.quote: I would say that it is pertinent to look at the overall coatings growth which is about 4.4% and even from a point of view of volume level, it goes to 8.3%.

facts.statement: The company operates in a discretionary category where consumption patterns are changing.
facts.quote: I also said that some consumption patterns are changing and given the fact that we are in a discretionary category, it also governs the growth that comes in this category.
